description: This file defines a PHP class 'PopupQuickCreate' that extends 'SubpanelQuickCreate' and handles a quick create form presented as a popup window in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment. It manages initialization and processing logic specific to the quick create popup UI.

classes.name: PopupQuickCreate
classes.description: A class representing a quick create popup window for a specified module, providing constructor and process methods to handle form initialization and display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the PopupQuickCreate object with module and view parameters, sets defaultProcess to false, and defines popup-specific buttons.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles processing of the quick create form, setting the form name and invoking processing and display methods of the associated view handler.
